note: Pack acceptance drills with their sha256. A drill spec never changes without an ADR amendment; a failed drill routes to fixing the pack and re-running. Read frozen_before_authoring on every entry: the Wave A eight were frozen before their pack content was authored (approved plan 12.3) and are independent oracles; the Wave B twelve were frozen on 2026-08-03, after their packs were authored and in the same commit as them, so they carry a weaker guarantee and could have been written to.

A.meaning: Spec committed before any pack content existed.

B.meaning: Spec and pack landed together; the spec is not an independent oracle.

fields.spec: The frozen copy under benchmark/drills/. Byte-identical to source.
fields.sha256: SHA-256 of the frozen copy at freeze time. A mismatch is a cannot-run.
fields.source: The pack's own drill proposal the frozen copy was taken from.
fields.wave: A or B. Wave A packs were authored first, Wave B second.
fields.frozen_before_authoring: True when the spec was committed before any of its pack's content existed, so the pack could not have been written to the drill.
fields.source_first_commit: First commit holding the drill spec.
fields.pack_first_commit: First commit holding the pack's PACK.md.
fields.how_to_read_it: Wave A specs landed in fb634ab and their packs in 00fbaba, four commits later, so the flag is true. Wave B specs and packs both landed in a43c20b, the same commit, so the flag is false and the evidence for it is in the two commit fields.
